Seven Ways We Take On Work

A requirement can arrive as a part number, a drawing, a tender document or a conversation. These are the engagement models we work under — most projects combine two or three.

Strategic SourcingInternational TradingSupply Chain CoordinationProcurement SupportIndustrial SupplyProject SupplyMarket Access

01

Strategic Sourcing

Identify suitable products, suppliers and commercial opportunities.

Sourcing begins with the requirement, not the catalogue. We define what the specification actually demands, map who can supply it credibly, and bring back options that can be compared on the same terms.

Define requirementMap supply optionsQualify sourcesCompare offersRecommend

02

International Trading

Facilitate commercial connections between buyers and suppliers.

We act as the commercial bridge between an international supplier and a regional buyer — negotiating terms, holding both sides to an agreed sequence, and carrying the transaction through documentation and delivery.

IntroduceAgree termsContractShipSettle
Submit an Inquiry → Related sectors

03

Supply Chain Coordination

Coordinate requirements from sourcing through delivery.

Where several suppliers feed one delivery date, someone has to own the critical path. We hold that role: consolidating schedules, flagging slippage early and re-planning around it.

PlanConsolidateMoveClearDeliver
Submit an Inquiry → Related sectors

04

Procurement Support

Support supplier identification, quotations and commercial communication.

An extension of your procurement desk for categories or geographies where you have no established supply base — running enquiries, chasing quotations and normalising offers for comparison.

EnquiryQuotationClarificationComparisonAward
Submit an Inquiry → Related sectors

05

Industrial Supply

Support industrial and infrastructure requirements.

Recurring supply of equipment, materials and consumables to operating facilities, planned around production schedules and maintenance windows rather than one-off orders.

Project Supply

Coordinate material and equipment requirements for projects.
